title: Knowledge changes
intro: See what each saved operation changed and the sources behind it.
historical: These are historical snapshots. Current knowledge and your corrections remain authoritative.
empty: No saved operations match this view.
select: Select an operation to compare its values.
verification_pending: More ancestry needs verification. Continue to load the next portion.
not_included: This history was not included in the export.
invalid_metadata: History could not be verified. Restart or check the local backup.
reset_required: Knowledge changed. Restart to view the latest history.
history_navigation_limit: The history navigation limit was reached. Restart with a narrower view.
history_unavailable: History is temporarily unavailable. Try again after the current operation.
source_missing: The original source is missing or unavailable.
source_changed: The original source has changed and cannot be verified.
source_denied: Current privacy rules exclude this source.
not_retained: Not retained by this operation; this does not mean it was false.
retention_policy_changed: Removed after the retention policy changed.
source_lineage: Updated through a unique shared evidence link.
support_added: Additional evidence supports the same claim.
support_changed: Supporting evidence changed for the same claim.
explicit_supersession: Replaced through an accepted explicit revision.
backup_restored: Restored by reversing a saved correction transaction.
restart_required: This history cursor expired or was replaced. Restart history to continue.
